calab.longDescription: Relates calcium activity to behavioral states, from place fields to social bouts, with shuffle-based null distributions and corrected p-values. Coming soon: this page is a placeholder while the port of the Python CaBaNA project is prepared.
features: One model for place cells, behavioral syllables and scored social bouts
Metrics such as information content, AUROC, PETH and decoders
Shuffle engine with circular-shift, block and bout nulls and corrected p-values
Per-cell evidence cards and cell classes
Imports Minian, CaImAn, DeepLabCut, BORIS and CaLab deconvolution output
